name: @rhythmjs/bullmq
description: BullMQ-backed job queues for Rhythm: the same typed job map and kernel module as @rhythmjs/queue, on full BullMQ — Redis-durable jobs, stalled-job recovery, Job Schedulers, and the whole BullMQ option surface.

scripts.build: bun build src/bullmq.ts src/types.ts --outdir dist --root src --format esm --target bun --packages external --splitting && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
